public.title: Add Two Numbers
public.description: The arrays encode nonnegative integers as singly linked lists of decimal digits in reverse order, least significant digit first. Return their sum in the same encoding. Each array contains 1 to 100 digits from 0 through 9, with no redundant most-significant zero except [0].
hints: Add aligned digits with a carry; avoid converting the full number.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Digit-wise addition supports integers longer than the safe-number range. O(maximum input length) time and output space; node identity is not checked.
